info.name: OpenMetadata APIs Agent Executions Test Case Results API
List of test case results for a given test case

params.name: fqn
params.description: Fully qualified name of the test case

params.name: startTs
params.description: Filter testCase results after the given start timestamp

params.name: endTs
params.description: Filter testCase results before the given end timestamp

items.docs: Get a list of all the test case results for the given testCase FQN, optionally filtered by  `startTimestamp` and `endTimestamp`. Use cursor-based pagination to limit the number of entries in the list using `limit` and `before` or `after` query params.

info.name: List test case results using search service

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields requested in the returned resource

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number tests case results returned. (1 to 1000000, default = 10)

params.name: offset
params.description: Returns list of tests after this offset

params.name: startTimestamp
params.description: Start timestamp to list test case from

params.name: endTimestamp
params.description: End timestamp to list test case from

params.name: testCaseStatus
params.description: Status of the test case -- one of Success, Failed, Aborted, Queued

params.name: testCaseFQN
params.description: FullyQualifiedName of the test case

params.name: testSuiteId
params.description: Test Suite Id the test case belongs to

params.name: entityFQN
params.description: Entity FQN the test case belongs to

params.name: latest
params.description: Get the latest test case result for each test case -- requires `testSuiteId`

params.name: testCaseType
params.description: Filter for test case result by type (e.g. column, table, all)

params.name: dataQualityDimension
params.description: Filter for test case by data quality dimension (e.g. OpenMetadata, dbt, etc.)

params.name: q
params.description: search query term to use in list

params.name: queryString
params.description: raw elasticsearch query to use in list

items.docs: List test case results from the search service. Use `startTimestamp` and `endTimestamp` to filter the results by timestamp. Use `testCaseFQN` to filter the results by test case fully qualified name. Use `testCaseStatus` to filter the results by test case status. Use `fields` to get only necessary fields.
